game.promotion.mike-exact-decision: The in-thread direction authorizes internal Workshop TEST treatment of the exact proven ancestor; it is recorded as human direction, not cryptographic identity proof and not CANON authority.
game.promotion.exact-byte-adapter: The promotion record binds the v0.1 packet and bundle digests and installs only the reviewed v0.2 package on this branch.
game.rollback.immutable-ancestor: rollback/first-generated-v0.1.json points to the immutable v2.5 source commit and exact request, packet, and bundle digests.
game.status.test-without-canon: The package is TEST on this review branch; installed in the canonical checkout and CANON both remain false.

game.content.generate.deterministic: The pure generator validates one declared native recipe and emits a byte-identical content packet; it does not synthesize arbitrary code.
game.generated-content.byte-lineage: The request, decision, ancestor, recipe, generated content, and release packet are digest-bound.
game.adventure.content-engine: The engine supports this bounded five-zone data contract, actors, items, quests, root gates, and ending; it is not a universal game engine.
game.growth.immutable-release: v0.2 is a new byte-bound release descended from v0.1; generation has no installation or promotion authority.

game.adventure.exploration: Five connected zones were traversed through the complete semantic and live browser journeys.
game.adventure.narrative: Authored keeper dialogue and a root-ordered story are present; human taste review remains open.
game.adventure.interaction: Twenty-five actor interactions are covered by the semantic completion test and the visible live journey.
game.adventure.quest-inventory: Six quests and ten inventory discoveries were completed and persisted.
game.adventure.ending: The authored ending routes the result into review and explicitly does not claim CANON.

game.runtime.game-hub-managed: Slot 020 passes the Game Hub package verifier and uses the allowlisted server entry contract.
game.runtime.no-outbound-network: The dependency-free game server exposes loopback HTTP only and the package declares no outbound network capability; this is not a general sandbox guarantee.
game.runtime.server-authority: State transitions are revision-checked on the server; stale revisions and malformed actions are rejected.
game.persistence.server-restart: Automated and live evidence both restored an exact completed state across a real server stop and restart.

game.verify.static-and-http: Package, schema, syntax, path, HTTP, and authority boundaries have focused automated assertions.
game.verify.complete-play-journey: The deterministic semantic journey completed in 202 moves; the independent visible-control browser journey completed in 192 moves.
game.verify.live-render-and-click: Desktop and narrow-width browser views were rendered and inspected; visible controls, help, interaction, reload, and the ending were exercised.
game.verify.keyboard-accessibility: Arrow-key movement and Escape-to-close-help were exercised in the live browser; no screen-reader or external assistive-technology claim is made.
game.verify.restart-recovery: The full ending and 192-move state remained visible after browser reload and after a real server restart.

game.install.separate-human-gate: Generator output cannot install itself; canonical integration remains an explicit Mike-controlled review action.
game.public-reuse-rights.hold: Internal TEST use does not resolve direct public copying rights; public reuse remains HOLD.
game.canon.self-change-denied: No generator, runtime, manifest, or receipt grants CANON authority.
foundation.direct-change.denied: This bounded diff does not modify Foundation paths and the generated content contract denies Foundation writes.
